title: MatMul
description: Computes C = A @ B, the workhorse of linear layers and attention projections. Recorded facts — Operator: MatMul; Math: C[i,j] = sum_k A[i,k]*B[k,j]; Shapes: [M,K]x[K,N] -> [M,N]. Used by ML engineers, compiler writers, and students to understand exactly what each layer computes.
demo:
# MatMul — runnable demo (python3)
# MatMul - softmax with temperature (python3)
import math
x=[2.0, 1.0, 0.5]
T=1.0
nd=4
m=max(x)
e=[math.exp((v-m)/T) for v in x]
s=sum(e)
out=[round(v/s, nd) for v in e]
print("softmax:", out, "sum=%.3f" % sum(out))
